article.title: Thirty days.
article.content:
Article124Thirty days.

The Schedule  ·  Third Division—Applications · Part I—Applications in Specified Cases
For a review of judgment by a court other than the Supreme Court.
Period of limitationThirty days.

Time from which period begins to runThe date of the decree or order.
